item.title: Xfwl4 – The Roadmap for a Xfce Wayland Compositor
item.description:
📝 Using xfwl4 should feel just like using xfwm4 on X11. Xfwl4 will not be based on the existing xfwm4 code. The first attempt at creating an Xfce Wayland compositor involved modifying the existing xfwm4 code to support both X11 and Wayland in parallel.
🔗 Read more: https://alexxcons.github.io/blogpost_15.html
